thread:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed across api-gateway (us-west-2). 5xx rate jumped ~3x at 00:12 UTC. Trigger: error-rate > 2% for 5m.

alex (oncall): ack — I'm on it. Paging SRE.

pagerduty-bot: Paging maya (sre) — on-call rotation.

maya (sre): I'm in. Looking at traces now. Early signal: a ton of 429s from rate-limiter (rl-service) followed by downstream 502/504s at gateway. Could be quota misconfig + retry storms.

jordan (infra): I can confirm a recent config push to rl-service at 23:58 UTC changed the default token-bucket for shared-tier to 10r/s -> 1r/s for a specific tenant flag. That would explain global exhaustion. Pulling the deploy history.

sam (prod-eng): Customer impact: telemetry shows ~15% of requests failing to completion for realtime endpoints (text-gen), latency tail increased (p95 from 120ms -> 1.2s). A subset of heavy tenants show >60% 429s.

maya (sre): Reproducing logs:
```
rl-service ERROR quota: tenant=tenant-42 consumed=1.5M bucket=shared-tier allowed=0 timestamp=2026-03-15T00:12:07Z
api-gateway WARN upstream timeout: 504 backend=server-gtw-3 req_id=abc123
```

lee (support): We're already getting inbound tickets from a customer in EMEA. Drafting short outage notice. Do we have an ETA?

alex (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) revert rl-service config change (rollback last deploy), 2) apply emergency per-tenant temporary increase for critical customers, 3) enable degraded-mode routing (route best-effort requests to backup pool). Who can run rollback?

jordan (infra): I'll rollback the rl-service config now. Command: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/rl-service --to-revision=3`

jordan (infra): rollback started. Watching pods come up.

maya (sre): While rollback is rolling, add a short-term token-bucket emergency override for tenant-42: `POST /admin/quotas/override {tenant: "tenant-42", rate: 50}` — Jordan, can you run this so we don't fully block them during restart?

jordan (infra): override applied via admin API. Response: `{status:ok, applied_to: tenant-42, new_rate:50}`

jordan (infra): rl-service pods are back, rollback finished. Health checks passing.

maya (sre): Monitoring graphs: 429 rate for tenant-42 dropped from 68% -> 6% in the last 2m. Gateway 5xx also trending down. Nice.

alex (oncall): Great. Can we verify that other tenants didn't experience bleed? Any sign of cascade?

maya (sre): We're seeing residual retry fanout in the ingress queue. Throttling at gateway edge is being tuned: `config rate_limit_global=2000` lowered to 1500 temporarily to damp retries. That reduced concurrent inflight by ~30%.

sam (prod-eng): Customer impact update: affected customers back to ~2-3% errors. I'll coordinate postmortem comms and add a temporary mitigations guide for SAs.

lee (support): Draft notice ready, will send once alex approves.

alex (oncall): Approve. Also open an incident ticket and assign to maya for RCA + to jordan for deployment guard rails. Include timeline + diff of the rl-service config change.

maya (sre): Filing INC-2026-0315-rl-quota-misconfig. Immediate action items:
- RCA: why the per-tenant flag was toggled in prod without canary.
- Engineering: add automated canary policy for quota updates and a kill-switch to stop global token-bucket fallback.
- Product: confirm list of critical tenants that get emergency overrides.

jordan (infra): We'll add a pre-deploy validator to CI to prevent scaling shared-tier from 10->1 without explicit approver.

alex (oncall): Handoff: maya will stay on for follow-up for the next 2hrs, then hand to next oncall @pager. Thanks all, incident moving to mitigation->postmortem phase. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigated — errors reduced to baseline, rollback + overrides applied. Postmortem assigned: INC-2026-0315-rl-quota-misconfig.
